note: Proposed verdicts for reviews/2025/consumers.json (not editable from a package worktree). retirement.annuity's question gained a sentence telling a survivor of a retiree to answer for the retiree's annuity (T-128), which reopened its two baseline pairs. Apply these and remove the two baseline entries consumer:retirement.annuity@i1040gi:p27 and consumer:retirement.annuity@i1040gi:p29.

consumer:retirement.annuity@i1040gi:p29.question_phrase: Is this a pension or annuity from a qualified plan, section 403(b) plan or tax-sheltered annuity, paid in periodic payments in which you have after-tax cost ... with an annuity starting date after November 18, 1996, and on that date you were under age 75 or had fewer than 5 years of guaranteed payments? ... If you are the survivor of a retiree, answer for the retiree's annuity
consumer:retirement.annuity@i1040gi:p29.source_phrase: i1040gi p. 29, Simplified Method Worksheet, line 9 (read by retirement.plan_taxable)
consumer:retirement.annuity@i1040gi:p29.reason: The worksheet page is the computation the question's Simplified Method conditions select (p. 30, conditions 1 and 2), and p. 30 tells a survivor of a retiree to use the retiree's annuity starting date and age, which the added sentence states.

consumer:retirement.annuity@i1040gi:p27.question_phrase: Is this a pension or annuity ... in which you have after-tax cost ... (This is when the Simplified Method applies.)
consumer:retirement.annuity@i1040gi:p27.source_phrase: i1040gi p. 27, line 4b, "If the distribution from your IRA is fully taxable, enter the total distribution on line 4b; don't make an entry on line 4a" (read by retirement.show_a)
consumer:retirement.annuity@i1040gi:p27.reason: retirement.show_a reads the input only to route a partly taxable plan annuity to line 5a as well as 5b; p. 27's rule turns on whether the distribution is fully taxable, which an annuity with after-tax cost figured by the Simplified Method is not, for a retiree or a survivor of one.

limits_proposed.note: Proposed ruling for reviews/2025/limits.json: a new limit sentence on a page the retirement form now cites (p575 p. 12, cited by retirement.recovered).

limit:p575:p12:7e883646.reason: The lifetime exclusion is limited to cost by Simplified Method Worksheet lines 7 and 8 (line 7 is cost less the amount recovered tax free after 1986, line 8 the smaller of line 5 or line 7); retirement.recovered asks a survivor of a retiree to include the retiree's recovery, so the limit covers both annuitants.
